## Skandha Media Services: cloud media operations: questions and answers

### What does Skandha Media Services do?

Skandha runs media operations for broadcasters, OTT platforms, content owners and rights holders: cloud media infrastructure, playout, VOD transcoding, content management, live sports and ad operations.

### Where is Skandha based?

Skandha is based in Andheri (E), Mumbai, with an office in Dubai Media City for the Middle East and North Africa.

### When was Skandha founded?

Skandha Media Services was founded in 2013 and has more than 200 employees.


## Media Capability Centres (MCC) | Skandha: questions and answers

### What is a Media Capability Centre?

A Media Capability Centre (MCC) is a central, cloud-based and AI-assisted hub that runs media operations end to end, including production, playout, archiving and monetisation, from one point of control.

### Why build an MCC in India?

India offers a large pool of skilled people, strong digital infrastructure, 24x7 multilingual operations and lower operating costs.

### How does Skandha build an MCC?

In four steps: discovery, design of a modular architecture, deployment of AI-led cloud systems, and scaling with more capabilities and automation.
